examples.arabic: الشمس كانت مشرقة جدًا في الصباح.
examples.english: The sun was very bright in the morning.
examples.transliteration: Ash-shamsu kanat mushriqatan jiddan fi as-sabah.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.english: There are happy female students in the morning.

examples.arabic: هم يشربون القهوة معا في الصباح
examples.english: They drink coffee together in the morning.
examples.transliteration: hum yashraboon alqahwa maan fi assabaah

examples.arabic: ذهبت إلى المقهى كعادتي فسمعت صوتا مألوفا يقول السلام عليكم صباح الخير
examples.english: I went to the cafe as usual and heard a familiar voice saying hello good morning
examples.transliteration: Dhahabtu ila al maqha ka adati fa samitu sawtan malufan yaqul as salamu alaykum sabah al khayr
examples.storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

examples.english: The teacher enters the classroom in the morning.

examples.arabic: انا ازور السوق كل صباح واشتري الورد
examples.english: I visit the market every morning and buy flowers
examples.transliteration: Ana azur as suq kulla sabah wa ashtari al ward
